newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices rise on fresh export interest.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices rise on fresh export interest.

text.p: Indian castor prices rose by eight rupees to 1,110/1,111 rupees on Friday on renewed buying and fresh export interest, dealers said.
"Reports of cloudy weather and scattered rain in southern India also arrested a further price fall. Any offseason rain at this juncture may delay new crop arrivals," one dealer said.
Groundnut oil fell to 401/402 rupees per 10 kg on improved arrivals of 140/150 tonnes coupled with sluggish buying.
Rajkot spot oil was steady at 550 rupees per 15 kg.
Bombay oil and oilseeds markets are closed on Monday for a Hindu festival.
